estimationGuidance.blindLabeling: Hide routeStratum and automated linkage columns from human labelers; use them only for sampling weights and post-label analysis.
estimationGuidance.deleteOperationResource: Sampled at higher density because it determines the operation-resource linked envelope around the cancellation candidate.
estimationGuidance.primaryEstimate: Compute stratum rates and a route-record weighted estimate using routeFramePopulationRecords. Route strata are exclusive for this sheet.
estimationGuidance.purpose: Use this sheet for route-record operation-vs-domain cancellation precision. Do not use it to update unique-family denominator claims.
